start.text: First day? Same team — I'm Sameer, desk behind yours. You looked at the window seat like it was a view. It's a parking lot. Give me your number, canteen tomorrow, I'll show you the good counter.

choices.text: Which counter is the bad one?

counter.text: The one with the queue. The queue is for the biryani. The biryani is a lie.

shared.text: Done. Go, go, your bus. Whitefield traffic at six is a personality test.

again.text: Tomorrow. One PM. Don't eat before.

coughing.text: (Sameer coughs into his elbow, then again.) PG food. It's always the PG food. Don't come close, I'm a biohazard. Kidding. Mostly.

back_pale.text: (Sameer, paler, a mask folded in his shirt pocket that he isn't wearing.) Tested for everything. Negative for everything. They said viral. Everyone's 'viral' this month.
